3395.title: Compose preview link routing
3395.rootCauseOneLine: Compose file previews omit the panel link callback; thread-detail previews already supply routing and desktop has an external-open fallback.
3395.proposedFix: Thread the existing panel callback through compose file previews; first verify the reported complete navigation failure in desktop.
3395.caveats: Two clean component runs confirm only the compose callback omission. Packaged desktop navigation, mailto and relative-file links were not exercised.
